name: FV_GTAS_DATA_ACT_REP_RUN
description: This table stores information about GTAS and DATA Act file reporting parameters.

columns.name: REPORT_RUN_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the report that is being run.

columns.name: BATCH_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The batch type that is being processed. It is based on the lookup ORA_FV_CREATE_FED_FILE_MODE.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the ledger.

columns.name: PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Period year for which the file is being processed.

columns.name: FROM_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: The from period name for which the file is being processed.

columns.name: FROM_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: The from period number for the file that is being processed.

columns.name: TO_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: The name of the to period for which the file is being processed.

columns.name: TO_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: The to period number for the file that is being processed.

columns.name: TREASURY_ACCOUNT_SYMBOLS
columns.description: Selected treasury account symbols for which the file is being processed.

columns.name: FILE_CODE
columns.description: Code associated with the file that is being processed. It is based on the lookup ORA_FV_DACT_FILE_NAME. Valid values are A, B, and C.

columns.name: TRIAL_BALANCE_CODE
columns.description: Code that represents the trial balance type.  It is based on the lookup ORA_FV_GTAS_TRIAL_BALANCE_TYPE.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_PERIODS
columns.description: Comma separated adjustment period names.

columns.name: RECOVER_EXCEPTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the report should process only exception transactions. A value of Y indicates that only execption transactions will be processed.

columns.name: RECALCULATE
columns.description: Indicates whether the transactions should be processed again.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the job that has been processed. Valid values are S, F, W, and I. S indicates success, F failure, W warning, and I in progress.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
